defaults:
  - base

hydra:
  searchpath:
    - pkg://verl.trainer.config

model_path: /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/qwen3_exp021_ragen_sft_v4

system:
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: "0,1"

micro_batch_size_per_gpu: 1
ppo_mini_batch_size: 32

trainer:
  project_name: cost-verify-agent-rl
  experiment_name: exp024-alfworld-success-gated
  total_training_steps: 30
  n_gpus_per_node: 2
  val_before_train: True
  test_freq: 20
  save_freq: 5
  local_log_dir: "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp024/"
  default_local_dir: "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp024/"
  logger: ['console']
  max_actor_ckpt_to_keep: 3
  resume_mode: "disable"

actor_rollout_ref:
  model:
    override_config:
      attn_implementation: sdpa
  actor:
    use_ref: True
    use_torch_compile: False
    use_kl_loss: True
    kl_loss_coef: 0.5
    kl_loss_type: kl
    clip_ratio_low: 0.2
    clip_ratio_high: 0.28
    loss_agg_mode: "seq-mean-token-mean"
    grad_clip: 1.0
    optim:
      lr: 5e-7
  ref:
    use_torch_compile: False
  rollout:
    response_length: 1024
    gpu_memory_utilization: 0.6
    max_model_len: 8192
    temperature: 1.0
    max_num_batched_tokens: 8192
    enforce_eager: True
    val_kwargs:
      do_sample: True
      temperature: 0.4

algorithm:
  adv_estimator: grpo
  gamma: 0.95
  high_level_gamma: 0.95
  norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: True

agent_proxy:
  max_turn: 30
  max_actions_per_turn: 1
  max_prompt_length: 4096

collapse_detection:
  multi_turn_enabled: false

es_manager:
  format_penalty: 0
  train:
    env_groups: 4
    group_size: 16
    env_configs:
      tags: ["AlfworldSG_SuccessGated"]
      n_groups: [4]
  val:
    env_groups: 16
    group_size: 1
    env_configs:
      tags: ["AlfworldSG_SuccessGated"]
      n_groups: [16]
EOF

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/cost-verify-agent-rl && python3 -c "
from RAGEN.ragen.env.alfworld.config import AlfredEnvConfig
c = AlfredEnvConfig()
print(f'defaults: score={c.score}, valid_action_bonus={c.valid_action_bonus}, success_gated_bonus={c.success_gated_bonus}')

# Simulate what AlfworldSG_SuccessGated tag does
c2 = AlfredEnvConfig(valid_action_bonus=0.15, success_gated_bonus=True)
print(f'exp024:   score={c2.score}, valid_action_bonus={c2.valid_action_bonus}, success_gated_bonus={c2.success_gated_bonus}')

# Verify reward math: 10 valid actions + success => 10.0 + 10*0.15 = 11.5
reward_success = c2.score * 1.0 + 10 * c2.valid_action_bonus
reward_fail = c2.score * 0.0
print(f'reward (success, 10 valid actions) = {reward_success}')
print(f'reward (fail) = {reward_fail}')
"
